field.name: organizer_ids
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_ORGANIZER
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, IF(short_name IS NULL OR short_name = '', '', CONCAT(' (', short_name, ')'))) AS text FROM #__dcl_organizations WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC
